title: RoofNet: A Global Multimodal Dataset for Roof Material Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Curating a globally diverse dataset across 184 sites in 112 countries and analyzing spatial distribution to ensure representation across distinct climatic, cultural, and architectural zones, thereby reducing the risk of region-specific overfitting.

Applying class-rebalanced sampling strategies during vision-language model fine-tuning and evaluating the model's performance on underrepresented minority material classes using confusion matrices on a held-out test set.
